definitions.explanation: relating to or depending on a specific individual rather than a system, role, or territory

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{属人|ぞくじん}{的|てき}になっている。
examples.english: This task has become dependent on a specific individual.

examples.japanese: {属人|ぞくじん}{的|てき}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{やり方|やりかた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to reconsider our person-dependent way of working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{属人|ぞくじん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{辞|や}めたとき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: When knowledge becomes concentrated in specific employees, the company suffers if those people leave.

notes:
A formal term meaning "belonging to or dependent on a specific person." In business contexts, {属人|ぞくじん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (becoming person-dependent) is considered a problem — when only one person knows how to do something, their absence creates risk. The opposite concept is {属地|ぞくち} (territory-based) in legal contexts, or ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧/⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (systematization) in business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {属人|ぞくじん}{的|てき}: person-dependent (adjective)
- {属人|ぞくじん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: becoming person-dependent
- {属人|ぞくじん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent person-dependency
- {属人|ぞくじん}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: personalism (in law: the principle of personal jurisdiction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {属地|ぞくち}: territory-based — the legal counterpart: based on location rather than person
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{的|てき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧: personal/individual — more general, without the negative connotation of dependency
